name: io.github.WendellResearch-AI/benchwarmers
title: Benchwarmers
description: Ask a collection of LLMs at once through your Benchwarmers server; verdicts pick the next panel.

environmentVariables.name: BENCHWARMERS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Benchwarmers server (default http://127.0.0.1:8122). Needs Python 3.11 or later on PATH

environmentVariables.name: BENCHWARMERS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A gateway key, needed beyond this machine or where the server requires keys

environmentVariables.name: BENCHWARMERS_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a panel (default 900)
